placeCatalog.layoutEvidence: GuiSaveDataPlaceInfo TDB type24879: string PlaceId, nonserialized ThumbnailIdCache, GUID AreaMessageId, GUID DetailMessageId. Each 64-byte serialized record: UTF16 string length11 at+0, 11 codeunits at+4, aligned areaGUID+0x20, detailGUID+0x30. All nonempty GUIDs matched extracted installed gui_savearea labels; Guid.Empty denotes no detail.

nativeLayouts.dictionary: entries+0x18, version+0x38, count+0x3C; entry stride0x18, next+0x04, key+0x08, value+0x10. Free entries have next<-1.
nativeLayouts.health: CharacterManager+0xB0 current player; player+0x70 hitpoint context; context+0x10 controller; setup byte+0x34; health int+0x28, max int+0x30.
nativeLayouts.weapon: Current player+0xF8 Common -> +0x10 owner -> +0x310 current weapon; exact PlayerEquipment metadata guard; +0x160 PanelState.
nativeLayouts.ammo: Native countLoadingStock uses minimum across loading slots. Reserve matches loaded ammunition ID across current weapon inventory loose-stock dictionaries+0x48/+0x50/+0x58, excluding loaded stocks and storage.
nativeLayouts.money: Current character catalog selects inventory user through native table. Normal Hand inventory credits+0x90 are independent of the equipped weapon; emitted only for Leon.
nativeLayouts.location: GuiManager singleton -> +0x48 current floor; +0x178 GuiMapBridge -> +0xA0 current section. IDs join installed map GUI labels. Recheck all pointers and controller+0x80 current scene before publishing. SaveSlotHeaderOperatorApp.PlaceID is deliberately unused: it retained Place_0504 after loading Grace in the hotel.
nativeLayouts.objective: Current objective list, latest ID with native last-entry fallback, runtime GUID/count and catalog maximum.

liveChecks.scope: Initial implementation; unchanged gameplay guards also covered by current regressions.

readerEvidence.mapCatalog: RE9-map-provenance.json: 172 unambiguous named sections across 46 named floors; unknown sections show the current region, unknown floors show Unknown location.
coverageLimits: Live tested Leon with two equipped guns, then Grace after loading another save in the same process, and Grace moving from Lounge & Bar to Kitchen.
Unarmed/dead states, temporal inventories, malformed layouts and missing/mismatched map data were tested with memory fixtures in the test process.
Unsupported polymorphic ammunition stock getters/converters fail closed instead of displaying guessed values.

Map labels can differ from save/load labels. The complete map catalog has not been traversed live. Conflicting or missing room-label mappings are omitted, with fallback only to the current map region.
Cheat Table Lua was tested with the installed Cheat Engine Lua5.3 runtime and read-only memory/UI shims, not a graphical CE UI session.
